figurative_meaning_en: A head burdened with useless or worthless things
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গোবরভরা মাথায় কোনো ভালো কথাই ঢুকবে না।
এই গোবরভরা মাথার লোকের সাথে কথা বলা বৃথা।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a cow-dung filled head; nothing sensible will enter it.
It's pointless talking to someone with a head full of rubbish.
note: This idiom draws from rural Bengali imagery involving cow dung, symbolizing waste and worthlessness.
